critical_code_review_comments: backend/server.py is now 5410 lines (grew from 5283). Launch results + anniversaries + public sessions all added to the same monolith. Split into routers (sessions, anniversaries, launch_reports) before 6k. Prior reviewer flagged the same.

Public /api/sessions filter `start_date: {$nin:[None,''}}` won't use an index optimally and still fetches with projection excluding body/gallery/testimonials -- fine for 200 docs but add partial index `{published:1, start_date:1} where start_date>''` for scale.

_send_anniversaries aggregates ALL approved volunteer_hours each day, then checks today's anniversary in Python. For large tables, add $expr/$month/$dayOfMonth match on first-approved aggregation (pre-filter in Mongo).

program_signup launch attribution runs find_one_and_update with projection missing -- fine, but the implicit `at` ISO string compare assumes consistent timezone format on insert; could silently fail if a seeded doc uses naive datetime. Document expected ISO.
Certificate endpoint uses `datetime.fromisoformat(a['at']).strftime('%B %-d, %Y')` -- the '%-d' is a GNU extension that fails on Windows; harmless on Linux containers but non-portable.
LaunchResults table lacks a sort indicator; UI shows sent_at '—' when launch_sent_at is unset (fine). Consider showing window_days in column header instead of banner text for compactness.

Sessions.jsx: on load the month auto-advances to first upcoming session's month -- but if user clicks prev/next and then the fetch re-runs due to state change, it would reset. Currently it doesn't because effect deps=[]. OK.
Admin seed warning banner 'Your website address isn't set' is noisy on every Admin tab; consider dismissible.
